rows.statement: Grow Heritage Pure Milk volume in the core South Indian states, defending share against Amul, Nandini and Dodla while converting loose/unbranded milk buyers.
rows.measure: MD & finance to set: volume growth % and/or share-point gain

rows.statement: Recruit new households to Heritage Pure Milk and lift repeat-purchase frequency, led by upgrading loose-milk and quick-switch families onto the daily home-delivery and GT habit.
rows.measure: new households added; repeat rate; subscription/home-delivery penetration

rows.statement: Establish 'Pure Doodh Ki Shakti' as the reason to choose Heritage over cheaper and loose alternatives — pure milk means real strength for the family — and make the unbroken cold chain believable.
rows.measure: prompted awareness of purity claim; brand consideration vs Amul/Nandini; message association with 'purity/strength'

rows.audience: Loose / unbranded milk families — buy from the local dairy or vendor, boil and use daily
rows.believes_now: Loose milk is fresher and cheaper because it comes straight from a known vendor; packaged milk is diluted or 'stale by the time it reaches me'. They will not pay more unless purity is made tangible — and their real fear is contamination and adulteration they cannot see. The functional pillar, proven by the unbroken cold chain, is the lever that turns their own purity anxiety toward Heritage. This is the biggest volume prize named in the marketing objective.

rows.audience: Quick-switch packaged families — already buy branded milk, currently Amul / Nandini / Dodla, low loyalty, buy on availability and habit
rows.believes_now: All packaged milk is roughly the same; they switch on what the kirana has that morning or on a small price gap. To move them Heritage needs a reason that isn't parity — the emotional pillar reframes the daily pour as what the family runs on, giving a why beyond price and shelf presence. Defends share against the named competitors.

rows.audience: Home-delivery / subscription households — already take daily doorstep milk or are open to it, value routine and reliability
rows.believes_now: Convenience is the point; whoever delivers reliably wins the standing order. Purity is assumed once they've signed up, so the job is to make the daily arrival feel like strength delivered, not just logistics. The emotional pillar deepens the habit the marketing objective wants to grow (subscription/home-delivery penetration) and raises repeat frequency.

rows.audience: Health-conscious young parents — nutrition-led, reading labels, feeding growing children, willing to pay for 'better'
rows.believes_now: They already believe milk quality matters and are actively choosing for the child's growth; they just aren't sure Heritage is measurably better. The emotional pillar — more of what a growing family runs on, better nourishment in every glass — is sourced and speaks directly to what they're already looking for. Smaller in volume than 1–3 but high value and vocal.

rows.channel: Long-form cold-chain film (the unbroken clock: pre-dawn milking to doorstep, timestamp ticking, never crossing the spoilage line) — Telugu / Tamil / Kannada / Hindi cuts
rows.medium: MEDIA LIST NOT SUPPLIED — client to name id
rows.job: Make the functional purity claim tangible to loose-milk families — turn their own adulteration fear toward Heritage
rows.measure: Claim recall + shift in 'packaged is diluted' agreement, pre/post survey — not views

rows.channel: Regional TV — South-language primetime, the steel-vessel-on-the-flame hero image
rows.job: Get to loose-milk and quick-switch families at scale who don't yet consider Heritage
rows.measure: Coverage % of target at effective frequency, cost per reach point

rows.channel: OOH — high-street and residential-cluster hoardings, vessel-and-cream-band visual
rows.job: Build mental availability near the point of daily purchase (kirana / local dairy)
rows.measure: Coverage of priority pin-codes, cost per reach

rows.channel: Vernacular digital video — 15s vertical reels, YouTube/Meta, emotional 'starts the day ahead' cut
rows.job: Reach quick-switch and young-parent audiences with the emotional reframe beyond price parity
rows.measure: On-target reach %, completed views at cost per reach

rows.channel: Kirana / general-trade activation — shelf branding, first-purchase offer, sampling at the counter
rows.job: Turn intent into the first packaged purchase where the switch actually happens — the shop shelf
rows.measure: Trial rate, cost per acquisition, new-buyer count

rows.channel: Home-delivery / subscription sign-up — doorstep flyer, first-week offer, app/phone onboarding
rows.job: Convert delivery-open households into standing orders and lift repeat frequency
rows.measure: Subscription starts, cost per acquisition, week-4 retention
